subject: Migrate sds.c unit tests to new test framework. (#478)
reason: The change only migrates sds.c's embedded SERVER_TEST unit tests into the new standalone unit test framework (new src/unit/test_sds.c, registration in test_files.h, removal of the old sdsTest entry from server.c's test table). No production code or runtime behaviour changes: the sds functions are untouched, and the deleted code was compiled only under SERVER_TEST. Nothing in a running server differs between the change and its parent, so no scenario can reach it.
